Tiny Tools

Tiny Tools is a small collection of helpers for working with text files. It is simple and has no dependencies.

Features

  • Count words in a file.
  • Remove duplicate lines.
  • Sort lines alphabetically.

Usage

Run the tool from the command line and pass a file name. The result is printed to the screen.

tiny count notes.txt
tiny sort notes.txt
